name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Functions

evidence.paas: 03: fully managed on-demand functions service; Oracle manages the OS and runtime in code-only deployments

line: Deploy event-driven functions on Oracle's managed serverless platform.

free.text: 2 million invocations and 400,000 GB memory-seconds monthly

cells.regions: Regional; examples in US, India, UK and Germany

work.math: 100 MB site, responses up to 6 MB. 1 million calls fit 2 million free, but run time at 512 MB is unknown. Gateway is $3. 100 GB sent out fits the unused 10 TB North America (NA) allowance. Other costs are unknown.

1 million calls × 250 ms × 0.5 GB = 125,000 GB-seconds, within 400,000 free. Gateway is $3. Assumes an archive up to 25 MB and an unused 10 TB North America (NA) data allowance. Logs, network and certificates are extra.
$3 for the gateway + $71.54 for a database surcharge (1 OCPU for 730 hours) + $0.72 for 10 billable GB. Base database compute and storage, 7-day backups, transfer and logs are unknown.
